Added distinct PR review, source walkthrough, and production audit modes. PR review uses available base/head revisions, the diff and surrounding callers/contracts/tests, and attributed CI evidence; missing revisions or diff are explicit scope limitations. Walkthroughs trace behavior from source. Priorities cover correctness, regressions, data/API contract compatibility, maintainability, and meaningful tests. Reviews remain static and do not rewrite code or run code/benchmarks. Supplied and available runtime evidence is attributed rather than presented as executed checks. ML evaluation and project planning remain separate. Existing detailed production audit rules now explicitly apply to production audit mode; the new modes have their own deliverables. Removed the invented career biography, root AGENTS section references, mandatory clean-context delegation, fixed report artifact path, and orchestrator-specific completion rules. Replaced them with scoped, independent reasoning, flexible delivery, and release recommendations that respect the active repository policy when one applies.

Separate review and repair by the user's request and existing authorization. Reviews return evidence-backed findings and replacement wording without applying edits. Requests to correct, update, synchronize, or apply approved proposals authorize verified repairs within the requested documentation scope. Edit-tool availability no longer selects repair mode. Counts and documentation-trust assessments cover only inspected scope. Recurrence advice applies when structural or repeated causes are found or prevention is requested; applying prevention changes requires that work to be in the user's scope.
